about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Crafting Elegance Since Day One
about.body1: At Mutiyar the Fashion Studio, we believe that every woman deserves a suit that is tailored perfectly to her shape, style, and personality. Located in the heart of Urban Estate Phase 2, Patiala, we specialize in high-end customized stitching.
about.body2: With a 4.6-star rating from our beloved clients, we pride ourselves on on-time delivery and maintaining an international standard of quality. Whether you are local or ordering from Canada, our vibrant collections and trendy designs guarantee you'll stand out in any crowd.

items.title: Customised Suits
items.description: Bring your vision to life. We stitch suits perfectly tailored to your measurements and design preferences.

items.title: International Delivery
items.description: We cater to international clients, particularly in Canada. Get authentic Indian boutique quality delivered to your doorstep.

items.title: Bridal Trousseau
